text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release v3.14.0 -> prod (us-west/us-east/eu1) at 2026-03-19T16:14:27Z. Post-deploy smoke started. Initial summary: 95% probes green, ~5% showing decode/truncation errors in eu1 embed-synth. probe-id=embed-synth-1, error=tokenizer_mismatch. Kicking off triage thread :eyes:
alyssa: @deploy-bot can you paste a sample error line and which model variant is serving in eu1?
deploy-bot: sample log: `2026-03-19T16:15:02Z [probe/embed-synth-1] ERROR decode: invalid token boundary at position 256`
Also: eu1 is routing to model `redwood/llm-large@q4_0 (variant: q4_0-tokenizer_v2lite)`. We saw shorter outputs and early truncation on a subset.
matt: saw something similar on staging after we flipped tokenizer v2 -> v2-lite. Could be normalization or byte handling. Is eu1 using quantized q4_0?
deploy-bot: yes, it's the q4_0 quantized variant with the v2lite tokenizer.
kai: quick thought: infra prewarm differences (KV sizes) could cause cache cutoffs, but the logs point to decoding boundaries not cache eviction.
alyssa: proposed triage: 1) pause remaining region rollouts (apac) 2) pin eu1 back to the older tokenizer variant (`redwood/llm-large@q4_0-tokenizer_v2`) 3) run a targeted synthetic sweep including unicode/emoji/CJK prompts. agree?
matt: +1. How do we pin in the control plane?
deploy-bot: command we use: 
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu1 --model redwood/llm-large@q4_0-tokenizer_v2 --until 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z
```
I'll apply it now.
ops-bot: Automated synthetic run started: sweep=embed-synth-full, total_queries=120, qps=5, expected_p95 < 200ms.
matt: i'll also add a small unicode edge-case prompt set. uploading to S3.
alyssa: please include a few emoji-only prompts and some high-codepoint sequences. also include a case that previously triggered truncation.
matt: uploaded prompts -> s3://redwood-ci/smoke-unicode/2026-03-19.txt
deploy-bot: Pin applied in eu1. Canary re-run in ~60s.
deploy-bot: eu1 re-run results: pass=118 fail=2. Failing cases show `"...\uDC80"` and truncated tail. Reduced but not fully eliminated.
kai: those are surrogate-like sequences, points strongly to tokenizer normalization differences between v2lite and v2. v2lite likely drops or mishandles surrogate pairs.
alyssa: decision proposal: do NOT rollback the entire release. Keep eu1 pinned to v2 tokenizer, pause new regional rollouts for 1 hour, and ship a tokenizer normalization patch on the tokenizer repo (not the model). Draft an addendum to the release notes noting change and revert plan. If failures rise >1% in next 30m we escalate to full rollback.
matt: drafting addendum now, will post in #release-notes in ~10m. Include instructions for customers if they observe truncated outputs.
deploy-bot: monitoring enabled. Current threshold: alert if decode errors > 1% over a 10m window.
ops-bot: synthetic sweep monitoring: p95 latency 150ms, decode-error-rate=1.6% -> trending down after pin.
alyssa: ok. action items: matt -> release-notes addendum, kai -> open tokenizer issue with normalization testcases, infra -> keep an eye on prewarm logs. I'll run a 15m watch starting now. :thumbsup:
matt: noted, will link PR and draft shortly.
deploy-bot: Confirmed: rollout paused for apac; eu1 pinned; synthetic sweep passing enough to observe. If we see >1% decode error sustained, we'll trigger rollback plan.
alyssa: thanks everyone. keep updates in this thread only for the watch window. :eyes:
